Agent Name: InformationExtraction_Expert
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The InformationExtraction_Expert made a fundamental logic error in Step 1. The task explicitly required calculating the distance between the "first and second atoms **as they are listed in the PDB file**". In the PDB file format, the first few lines are metadata (HEADER, TITLE, etc.), and the actual atom records start later (often at line 10 or later). By using `list(structure.get_atoms())`, the code retrieves atoms based on the internal parsing order of the Biopython library (which typically orders by chain and residue number), not the strict sequential order of the lines in the raw text file. The expert failed to implement the specific requirement to parse the file line-by-line to identify the first and second *atom records*, instead relying on the default object iteration which likely selected the first atom of the first residue (e.g., N, CA, C) rather than the absolute first atom record in the file (which might be a different atom or require skipping non-atom lines). This led to an incorrect distance calculation.
